'argyu babazhi bas spru zhi rnam thar/lho/ri tsho po /rdo
rgyu dbade bsha babazhi /mu bad/bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang /

sprul pa'i rgyal po sang btsan sgam po de me mo glang gi lor yab gnam ri srong btsan dang / yum 'bri bza' thod dkar gyi zas su yul rlon zhes pa'i dbu ru mal gro rgya ma pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling du thu ba mas/ dbu gtsug tu sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' mas kyi zhal rang // gi byung ba la yab kyis dar le bgon gyi la thod dbu la gsol de ci yab kyis ma mi tā ba'i zhal sped phyir/ le brgan dar gyis dbu sha cad du mdzad/ nang 'khor las sgrib zab pa rnams kyis ni rigs ze'i da rgyan bcu gcig zhal du mthong / mgar dang thon mi bya ba'i khyi'i chud gnyis/ blon po zhe sa 'bul ba'i phyir 'brangs pas/ ma tā ba'i zhal mthong phyir bsnyad stabs rgya'i bu dbu gnyis ldan thar :grags su skad dga' ston dpag yas nyin zla bcad mar byas/ khri grong btsan zhes mtshan du gsol ba las/ yon tan kun ldan skyisgo tu thug gidzubapas/ mtshagadu srong btsan sgam po zhes su grags/ snyis

so/ zong btsan lham po dgung 'o bcu gsum gyi dus su rgyal srid kyi khri la mnga' gsol/ 'khor los sgyur ba des bod rje'i rnam pa'i tshul du mdzad/ de nas sprul pa'i rgyal po srong btsan lham po des lha sa dmar po ri stag bye khung du 'dzul ba 'dra ba'i steng gi sku mkhar nang bzhugs/ngas kha ba can gyi mi rnams lha mi'i bde ba dang nyan rang gi bde ba la bkod kyang don chen por mi 'gyur bas na thed pa'i byang chub lam la 'god dgos/ de la theg pa chen po'i chos dar bar bya'o snyam nas tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i sku la mchod de gsol ba btab bo/ gsol ba btab ma bag tu tsan dan gyi sku des khyod kyis nga yi sku zhig bzhings zhig ces gsung byon pa dang / rgyal po nyid kyis sku bzhengs pa'i yo chas tsan dan go shir sha dang / chu bo ra dza'i bye ma/ sto rgya mtsho'i ming gi 'jag ma/ 'jim pa'i nga po sogs sa ba gas nas yi dam thugs rje chen po'i sku ji bzhin bzheng dgos par shar ba dang nang par rgyal po nyid kyi yid la 'dod pa ji lta ba bzhin rgyags rje chen po'i sku rang byon du byon nas gda'o/ rgyal po'i ༄ gas la de tsan dan sgro gyi snying po'i ye shes mas pa'i tshul du brgyags na ci ma rung sna ma sto ga tu 'jim pa'i sku de yi sgrubs ma la la 'od ra 'phro rta tshan dan gyi sku de dag thugs kur 'thims/di nas rgyal po dgung tshu ma cag so dang 'ji rsā

gyi khyim thab btsun mo khab tu ba par da nga te thugs rje chen po'i thu rang byung la gsoladzo bta bas zugs ka nas 'od zer gnyis 'asgro te/ gcig bal yul dang / gcig rgya nag tu song 'od zer de gnyis so sor song ba'i phyogs su gzinas pas/ bal po'i rgyal po go zer go cha zhes bya bar zas mo lha gcig khri btsun zhes bya ba dgung lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can mtshan dpes mdzes shing / lha mo khro gnyer can gyi sprul pa/ rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag dang longs spyod mnga' brnyes pa zhig 'dug pa gzigs pa dang / yang rgya nag rgyal po thang tha'i dzung zhes bya bar sras mo lha gcig kong jo dgung lo bcu drug la son pa na tshod can mtshan dpes mdzes shing / lha mo sgrol ske'i sprul ba lung rig mtha' dag la mnga' brnyes pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi bang mdzod dang ldan pa zhig 'dug par gzigs pa sogs rmi lam du 'od gsal lha yi lung bstan byung ba na/ nang par chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po des za 'og gi ber chen sku la gsol dbu gtsug gi rig bdag ngas 4rgyas ma mi tā lha la dar le brgan gyi na ba 'a la sgod dbu la gsol/ phyag g.yas su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi nga po ༷ ge drug ma rin po che'i sgrom bu nor bu'i phra tshom gyis mdzes pa 'khor lo dang / phyag g.yon du 'o ma shel sge ci brgya dang brgyad calha mas shing / zhal nas yi ge drug pa'i gsung dbyangs sgrogs 1skyiste po mgar ba dang thon mi kun tu bzang po la sogs pa'i nang

blon rnams la zi lam lub bstan byung tshul gyi mgur de bzhes so/ma ma nyon dang nga mi blon 'bang rnami rtenab ma ga ngas gtamade mags par nyon/ nga la zi lam lung bstan 'di ra byung / rgya bal sras mo sgrol ma'i sprul pa gnyis/ nga yi btsun mor bod du gdan drangs na/ bod khams gtan gyi bde skyid byung bar nges/ ces ga stongs pa dang / blon po mgar dang / smon mi kun tu tho nga po la sogs pa'i sna chen blon po mi bdun gyis gtsos pa'i nang blon rnams 'o nga mtsho 'gram gyi ljon shing bsil grib 'og tu rang rang gi smos ma'i shab nga po gzugs re khyer nas gros rwar 'tshogs pa dang / sha rnams ciphyogs bsku ga tu bsdus pa na sha khog pa ma nyams pa zhig byung bas gros kyi thog ma'i rten 'brel legs par 'grigs shing / blon po mgar bas rgyags dgyes bzhin du gsungs par/rang cag 'di na 'dus pa'i blon po'i tshogs/ mgar bstong btsan phyogs la rna ba nyon/ rgyal po'i ma la lam lha mi'i lung bstan du/ sgrol ma dkar smon sprul pa'i jo mo gnyis/ rgya dang bal rje'i zas mor 'khyung nas 'dug de 'dra btsun mor 'os sam bka' gros mdzod/ ce gsungs ba dang / 'dir yod blon po thams cad na btsun mo khyad 'phags can de gnyis rgyal po'i khab tu 'dren par gros 'chams/ rgyal pos gsungs don/ da 'o na ston zla rwa ba'i tshes ba da rgyu ra rgyal la babs pa'i dus su nyi ma ri rtser shar ba dang / sgo ma

migar gyis gtso byas pa'i rta pa brgyas gsor gyi dong rtsi brgya dang /ga ra gyi bab la rin po che'i phra btab pa dang / nga yi bka' zhog sgrom bu 'di rnams khyer la 'phags ma sgrol ma khro gnyer ma'i mtshan na brjod cing / nub phyogs bal po'i yul du song zhig don 'grub par 'gyur ro/ bal po'i rgyal pos bu mo ster mi 'dod pas khyod la 'dri ba lan gsum du bya 'ong gi/ 'dri ba re bzhin nga yi bka' shog gi sgrom bu re rim gyis snang cig ceglebaka' shog sgrom bu gsum dang bcas nub phyogs b.lazasa'i skyalagadub kas mngags so/ga bo blono po de rnams de ma thag tu nub phyogs bal po'i yul du slebs / bal po'i rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i drung du bod kyi blon bo rnams pa ra na bkra shis pa'i mjal dar gyis sne drangs/ rin po che gagi khrib sogs 'bul rten rnams bal rje'i mdun du phul nas blo yopa gar gyis bal rjer gsol bar/ nub phyogs sto bal yul gyi rgyal po khyed/ bod kyi blon po bdag cas gson dang / bkra shis mjal dar de yis thog drangs pa'i/rinab natsanaser gyi bab sogs skyes rnams 'bul/ khyed kyi sras mo lha gcig khri btsun de/ nga cicag rgyal po'i btsun mor gnang du gsol/zhes zhus pa na bal po'i rgyal pos khrel zhing dgod pa dang ci yang mi sbo bar mig btsums nas ring mor bsams rjes 'di skad cas smras so/— gas par nyon dang bod kyi blon po rnams/ bod yul ma/'a

'khob dgi bcu'i khrims ni da/ nga mi bu mo'i gnyen zla de mi yong /gal te dge bcu'i khrims la gnas zer na/ nga yi bu mo bod du sbyin pas chog ces bod du dge bcu'i khrims bca' nus min gyi 'dri ba dang po byas nas bod rje'i bka' lan dgos zhes gsungs pa dang / blon po mgar gyis sprul pa'i rgyal po'i bka' lung de yid la khru lam mer dran nas bal rjer btsan pos gnang ba'i 'phrin zhig yod ces gser las byas shing bal po'i yi ger bkod pa'i bka' shog gi sgrom bu dang po de bal rje'i phyag tu phul ba dang / bal rjes gzigs/ de'i nang ngas rnyi yo gcig la sku lus kyi bkod pa lnga stong du sprul na bod kha ba can snyi rgyal khams su dge ba bcu'i khrims bcas la bzhag gis de ngo mtshar mi che 'am zhes 'khod pa mthong ba dang / bal po'i rgyal po'i thugs la de bden nam mi bden/ gal te bden na nga yis kho tso mir dka' ba zhig 'dug snyam ste/ yang bal rjes gsungs par/ bod kyi btsan po'o khas len bzang na yang / bod yul mtha' 'khob rten dang lha khang med/ gtsug lag khang dang rten gsum bzhengs zer gi/ khri btsun bod ri'i btsun mor ster bar bya/ ces thu gsung rgyags kyi rten bzhengs nus min lan dgo/sa pa'i 'dri ba gnyis pa byas pa3 zang kyi blo pos yang dngul gyis bris pa'i bka' shog gi sgrom bu gnyis pa de bal rje'i phyag tu phu'agabs/ bal rjes bzags nas de'i —nang ngas nyin mo gcig la sku lus kyi bkod sha lnga stong du sprul nas bod

du gtsug lag khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhings te sgo thams cad nub phyogs bal po'i stal du bstan la ba ga gis de la ngo mtshar mi che 'am shes 'khod pa mthong bas/ der bal po'i rgyal po'i thugs dgongs la 'di ni ngas thub par dka' ba zhig 'dug bu mo ma sbyin na ni khos de tsam gyi sprul pa byas nas dmag drangs te nga bsad/ nga'i grong khyer rnams bcom/lha gcig khri btsun mang dbang med du khyer ba 'dug do bas ster dgos par nges bsams kyang ster ba'i khas ni ma blangs par slar yang bod kyi blon po rnams brtan mi brtan gyi brtag pa'i snyir 'dri ba gsum pa bton par bal rje'i zhal nas/nga la 'dod yon lnga yi longs spyod yod/ bod yul mtha' 'khob dbul bas 'ongs spyod chung / 'dod yon longs spyod nga dang 'gran nus na/ nga yi lha gcig bod rje'i btsun mor ster/ ces sbos pa dang /yang blon po mgar gyis bka' shog gi sgrom bu gsum pa de bal rje'i phyagatu phul bas/ de'i nang khyed kyis lha gcig khri btsun de bkas gnang na/ ngas bod du 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la sog ba'i yid du 'ong ba'i longs spyod rnam pa sna tshogs su sprul nas mthar rgyal kha ga na gyi nor lojus spyod thams cad kyang nga'i rgyal khams la rag lus pa zhig bya yis de la ngo mtshar mi che 'am/ zhes 'khod pa mthong ba dang bal po'i rgyal po de shin tu 'jigs shing skrags nas/ kho mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal po'i sgom bu la da pa mi 'dug la/ bod rjer rnam ma yang bsdum

gis mi khyab pa mnga' bas bu mo sbyin pa rang drag snyam nas/ bal rjes lha gcig khri btsun yab kyi drung du bkug nas mas mo khri btsun la 'de da ces gsungs so nga yi snying nas brtse ba'i lha gcig khyod/ rna ba ma ga nga yab kyi ngag 'di nyon/ bod rje sprul pa'i rgyal po srong btsan de'i gtan gyi 'dun mar khyod nyid 'gro bar rig ces gsungs pa dang lha gcig khri btsun des yab kyi drung du pus mo sa la btsugs nas phyag dang bcas te 'di skad ces gsol lo/brtse ba'i yab gcig bu mo bdag la gson/ kha ba can de chos da grang ngar che/ yab yum spun mched bral bas sems pa skyo/ de 'dra'i yul du bu mo dgong pa zhu zhes zhus pa dang / yab rjes mar yang lha gcig la 'di skad ces gsungs so bu mo kha ba can du ma phyin na/ bod kyi rgyal po lha yi sprul pa yin/kho mas dmag drangs nga bsad rgyal khams bcom/ bu mo khyod kyang dbang nad 'grog par nges/ ces gsungs kyang / lha gcig khri btsun de // / / sdu/ / rdo ṭwāṃ thabs kyis slar ding yab rjer phyag dang bcas nya gye ma yab gcig rgyal po bdag la gson/ bod di gdol rigs mchod pa'i rten sogs da yab kyi mchod gnas shākya mu ni dang /rin chen bang ma da bdag la gnang du gsol/ ces zhus pa na/ yang

rjes gsungs zur/ bdag gi mchod pa'i gnas kya mu no 'de ni yon bdag lha yi dbang pos byas pa dang / chos sku'i rgyu ni rin 3na sna tshogs las grub cing / bzo bo lha yi bai rtu mirnyes byas/ sangs rgyas nyid kyis rab gnas mdzad cing byin gyis brlabs/ de la mchod pa byas na sangs rgyas dngos la mchod pa dang dbyer med pa sangs rgyas nyid kyis zhal cagyis bzhes pa sogs yon tan dpag tu med pa'i 6bdam gyi lha 'di dang / 'phags pa wa ti bzang po dang / byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo/ tsan dan 'phags ma sgrol ma bcas ma da pa'i gnas 'di rnams bdag gi snying dang 'dra bas phangs na yang brtse ba'i bu mo khyod la rten skal rdu sbyin par bya/ gzhan yang rin po che'i bang mdzod bdun las nor sna khyad 'phags du ma bu mo'i skal du ba nga par bya/ zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / bu mo khyod kha ba can du phyin nas khyod kyi bsam /dri /rdo /da pa 'di ltar gyis shig ces yab kyi zhal nas 'di skad ces ༄ bu mo kha ba can du phyin nas kyang / lta spyod gtsang zhing chos la dad pa mdzod/ grogs la gus zhen 'bangs la byams skyong dang / lus 'tshag dam zhing longs spyod shes par gyis/ ces gsungs nas rten skal rnams dang / rin po che'i bang mdzod bdun las nor sna glang po che'i rgyab khal bdun/ gzhan yang lag shes mkhas pa'i bzo rigs sna tshogs dang / 'khor du ma/ khri btsun gyi chibs dre'u dkar ma la

spung gi blon po dang ba da ga rna yab kyi bkas mngag8 skelha gcig khri btsun thus thabs kyis ma trebazlogs par yab kyi bka'abazhin bod du 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes te glang po che ba zhig la jo bo shākya mu ni'i sku chibs/ dre'u dkar mo gcig la khri btsun chibag tsan dan gyi sgrol ma phyag tu bsnams shing rten gsum rnams dang / nor sna glang po'i rgyab khal mang po/ bal po'i blon dmag gi skyel ma dang bcas chibs rdog thon te shar phyogs snye ta'i nags su phyag phebs pa dang / de nas bod dmag gis bsus shing bal bod sa mtshams kyi gyes khug bya ba nas skyid grong gi bar lam 'phrang dog cibs blang po che dang bal dmag rnams phyir bslogs/ ci rin po che rnams blon 'khor gyis rgyab tu khur/mi dam gyi lha rnams so so'i zhabs kyis bcag nas —dngos su byon da/bod khongs skyid grong du phebs mtshams ribod nas khri btsun gyi phebs bsur chibs dre'u dkar mos thog drangs pa'i rin po che 'a la khal rta bzang lnga brgya dang bcas 'byor ba phyag phebs shing / 'phags pa thugs rje chen po wa ti bzang po skyid grong du bzhag de nas khri btsun mi dam dang bcas pa bod yul lha sa'i thil du phyag phebs pa'i tshe/chos kyi rgyal po srong bcan sgam po dga' ston gyi sa ru spyan drangs nas lha gcig khri btsun dang ma la ba'i dus su snang ba ba nga pos bod khamasayongs la khyab par byung ngo /10 de nas ba bzas rin po che snad mi 'dra ba gsum gyi nang du

bal yu'akhagyi go la dang / rgun 'brum/ 'bras nga la sogs ba'i skyems dang / ro brgya ldan pa'i bza' btung mang po drangs nas rin po che'i maṇḍal phyag rten du phul/ de'i dus su gle so sgro bo rnams dang byang chub sems pa/ de bzhen gshegs pa bcas kyi gzigs tshul 'dra ba gsum byung ngo / ride na rgyal po nyid ni yi dam gyi lha'i drung du mi 'bral bar bzhugs pa na/ bal bza'i bsam par rgyal po 'di thu byad lha bas mchog mi shes pa ngo mtshar che ba zhig 'dug kyang pho brang gi snyi rol du ye —nas mi 'byon ba ci/ de don dri bar bya ba la ni khong gis bal skad mi shes/ nga yis bod skad ni mi shes/ khong phyi rol gyi da ga la 'jig pa na nges/ de la ngas bde bas thabs shig bya dgos snyam/de ltar nga mo lug gi lo la dmar po ri steng du mkhar gyi rmang bting spyopho brang ga ri'i rgya khyon du dpag tshad gcig yod pa dang / spu ba so phag gi ga pa dpangs gang phred sum cu rtsa drug gi tshad bskor/ mtho nga rgya che ba ste logs re la rgyang grags re yod pa/ sgo bzhi sgo spe rta babs dang / chung khang pa mda' yab pu shu bcas rin po che sna tshogs las byas ma'i bang chung gis bskor/ mu tig gi dra ba dra da dril bu g.yer kha'i sgro snyan pa sil sil du khrol ba rnga yab ba dan gyis —brgyan/ de lta bu'i lta na thug pa bang khyer thos ldan dang tshul mthun pa'i lcags ri'i nang du mkhar dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa dgu dang / //ra

me yi da la du rtse mo mtho ba gcig dang bcas stong du tshang ba rdo rna kyi rtser dar dmar sked khra can btags pa'i mdung dmar bcu re / zog shing mtshon cha sna tshogs pa gzengs pa dar gyi chun rmesgyung shatshogs pa bris par byas/ sto'i lcags ri'i nang du sog po'i mkhar la cidape blangs nas brag lha bkra shis gzhal yas khang zhes bya ba thog dgur ba gas pas rgyal po'i sku mkhar dang btsun mo'i pho brang gi bar du dngul zam skar khung bkra zhing rgyan mtha' yas pa bcas kyis spel ba la yab yum phan tshun du gshegs brgyad mdzad/ dmag dung phyur lhags kyang srung ma mi lngas thub pa rnam par —rgyal ba'i khang bzang ltar legs nga bltar mi ngoms pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar 'od zer 'bar zhing —ba bar mi bzod pa/ sris yul laṅka pu ri ltar 'jigs shing rngam pa ga brtsigs so/ de'i shar sgo'i phyir rgyal po'i chibs dkyu sa sa 'dom dgu brgyar ring zhing / zhing 'dom bco brgyad/ zab 'dom do byas par shing so phag gis phub ste zangs mas g.yogs pa/ logs su dra ba dra phyed dang bkra shis skyu ri mo sna tshogs pa bris shing 'bur du gtod pa tshon sna tshogs pa byugs pa gyi nang gser lta bu 'dug pa de'i nang rgyal po'i chibs dkyus pa'i rtsig spa re chore la'ang rta pa 'bum gyi mig sgro dang byur mnyam/ sil khrol gyi sgro skad rol mo sna tshogs par grags/ de lta bu'i pho brang dmar po grong khyer chen po rnams kyi bkod pa dag bal bza' khri btsun gyis byas par grags so/12

de yang blon chen po mgar gyis nyin zhig chos rgyal srong btsan po'i drung du bcar nas rgya nag gi lha gcig de'ang khyed kyi btsun mor gdan 'dren pa'i bka' gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ rgyal pos gser gyi dong tse brgya bskur nas 'di zhu rten gyis/ rin po che'i bab la padma rwa ga'i phra brgyan pa zhig bskur nas 'di lha gcig de'i rin du phul cigargya nag rgyal pos bka' mi 'dra ba lan gsum bskud mar gsung du 'ong gis de'i dus su 'di gsum re re bzhin gtod cig gsungs nas bka' shog gi zhog sgril gsum bskur ro/ blon po 'khor bcas la lam bgrod yo chas gos dang rgyan la sogs pa rta drel la bkal ba'i khal mang po dang bcas ba ngas nas/ nyin mtshan dang lam 'phrang gang du'ang rī btsun sgrol mar gsol ba 'debs kyin du song zhig gsungs so/ de nas blon po mgar gyis rgyal pos bskur ba thams cad khyer/ khal rnams ded nas blon po rta pa brgya dang mnyam du me pho sprel lo zla bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad skar ma rgyal dang 'dzoms par rgya nag tu chas so/ de nas rim gyi song ste rgya nag zin zhing grang man bkra shis khri sgo rgya rje thang the dzung bzhugs sa'i pho brang gi sgo drung du slebs pa na/ der mi khyim 'bum tsho yod cing / logs re la nyin lam re tsam gda' ba'i sgo mo che bzhi yod pas/ mthong ba dang rngam zhing 'jigs pa zhig 'dug go/de'i dus su rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po'i blon po rta pa brgya tham pa rgya ske kong jo 'dod par thebs/ ge sar dmag gi la po'i blon po /rgya —

tham pa yang rgya mo kong jo 'dod par slebs/ ta ga nor gyi rgyal bo'i blon tha rta pa brgya tham pa yang kong jo 'dod par slebs/ lha ta hor gyi rgyal po'i blon po rta pa brgya tham pa yang kong jo 'dod par slebs/ mi rigs mi 'dra ba'i rta pa lnga brgya rgya rje'i drung du dus gcig tu 'dzoms so/rgya gar pa rnams shar sgor bsdad/ gi sar ba rnams lho sgor ba da/ta zig ba rnams nub sgor bsdad/ lha ta hor rnams byang sgor ba da 'ad blon rnams byang shar mtshams su bsdad do/ rgya nag gi sras rgyal rwasko kon sar dmag gi rgyal po khong dpa' rtsal che bas lha gcig kong jo kho4 la ster zer nas bang chen btong / yum na re nged kyi longs spyod bas bod kyis nged tsho'i longs spyod kyi do mi nus/ rgyal po longs spyod mi ldan sprang po 'dra zhes zer bas/ ta zig nor gyi rgyal po longs spyod che zhing dus ngan pa byung na zas nor dgos pas lha gcig ta zig ci nor gyi rgyal por ster zer nas bang chen btang / lha gcig kong jo na re mi tshe rim gyis 'gro dgos pas na gtso bo mi rang gal che stabs lha ta hor gyi rgyal po gzugs bzang bas hor la 'gro zer nas bang chen btang / yab rgyal po na re dam pa'i chos de rgya gar nas dar zhing khong drin che bas/ rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po la ster zer nas bang chen btang / de nas blon po gzhan rnams zhu rten byas nas mjal 'phrad byas/ bod blon rnams ni mjal bar zhus kyang sgug tu bcug nas zhag bdun song ba dang / nyin zhig rgyal po 'khor bcas pho brang phyi rol du byon pa na spron

po mgar gyi ga ra gyi dong bdun po rgya rten du phul/ rin po che'i bab ma padma nā ga'i phra ba na pa de rgyal po'i drung du bzhag ste mgar bsazhus par/ rgyal tha chen po/ bab 'di'i yon tan du ma dang ldan te/mi nad dang / phyugs nad byung ba'i tshe bab 'di gyon nas grong khyer la skor ba byas na nagathams cad zhi bar 'gyur/ sad dang ser ba byung ba'i tshe 'di gyon nas zhing la bskor na sad dang ser ba yang zlog thub/'khrugs pa byung ba'i tshe khrub 'di gyon na g.yul las rnam par rgyal bar glu'agyur ro/ 'dzam bu'i gling na bab 'di la gong thang bcad pas mi chodapha 'di gi lha gcig gi rin du 'bul rgyu yin pas khyed kyis lha gcigamadzang ma de nged bod kyi rgyal po'i btsun mor gnang bar zhu byas pas/rgyal bo blon po mgar la mig 'bur tshugs su bltas pa dang / rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis mi 'os pa'i khrel dgod chen bo bgad/ rgyal pos 'a skad cas gsungs so/ mi srid pa'i gtam shin tu ngo mtshar tshe/ gi rgya nag spyo bo'i rgyal po nas bzung deng sang gi bar du rgyal rgyud ma da pa zhig min/ khyod bod kyi rgyal pos nga'i stobs dang mnga' thang gi do mi 'pher/ 'od kyang khyed tsho thag riganas phebs 'dug par/ galan phyir log ste khyod kyi rgyal po de la dge ba bcu dang ldan pa'i rgyal 5khrims 'a 'amu nus dris la shog de nus na bu mo ster/ mi nus na mister zer bas/ blon po mgar na re/ 'phrin re la rgya bod bar bar 'a tshur 'ong bya na ga ring bas lha gcig spyon 'dren gyib pa'i 1 ca —

thabazlo med khyed kyi gsung 'di'i lan du nged bod kyi rgyal pos 'di bskur ba lags zer nas zhog sgril dang po 'di rgyal po'i phyag tu phul ba dang / rgyal pos kha phye nas gzigs pa'i tshe/ mthing shog la gser gyis bris pa'i rgya yig gi nang don du/ khyod rgya nag rgyal po la khrims yod/ nged bod kyi rgyal po la khrims med/ khyed dge ba bcu'i chos khrims yod pa la dgyes nas bu mo bye ra na/ ngas sku lus kyi bkod pa dzi stong du sprul nas dge bcu'i chos khrims nyin gcig la 'cha' nus par bya'o/ de ngo mtshar mi che 'am zhes bya ba 'dug pas/ rgyal po na re/khyod bod kyi rgyal po de kha pho che bar 'dug khyod bod kyi yul la gtsug lag khang rtsig nus pa'i stobs yod dang med/ de yod na bu mo ster la med na mi ster/ khyod phyir log ste dris la shog gsungs pas/ yang mgar na re/ rgyal po khyed kyi gsung 'di'i lan du 'di bskur ba lags pas gzigs par zhu zer nas shog sgril bar ma de rgyal po'i phyag tu phul/ rgyal pos kha phye nas gzigs pas/ khyed rgya nag yul du chos dar gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i stobs yod/ nga bod kyi rgyal poragatsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i nus pa medaka/ rgyal po khyed gtsug tshog khang bzhengs par dgyes nas lha gcig ster na nged kyis sku lus kyi bkod pa lnga stong du sprul nas gtsug lag khang brgya rtsa brgyad brtsigs te sgo thams cad khyen kyi phyogs su bstan par byas na/ de ngo mtshar mi che 'am zhes bya ba 'khod 'dug pas/ rgyal po na rda/ khyod kyi snyol

po 'de kha pho na tu che ba 'dug khyod rkye yul la 'dod yon longs spyod yod dag da/ de yod na bu mo ster la med na mi ster/ da song la dris nas shog gsungs pas/ yang blon po mgar gyis shog sgril mtha' ma de rgyal po'i phyag tu phul nas de lan 'dir yod pas gzigs par zhu byas pa dang / rgyal pos gzigs/ 'di ltar khyed rgya dag rgyal po la nor longs spyod yod/ nga bod kyi rgyal po la longs spyod 'di ltar med de/ rgyalapo khyed nor longs spyod yod pa la dgyes nas bu mo ster na/ ngas sku lus gyi bkod pa lnga stong du sprul nas gser dngul gyi longs spyod 'bru/ dar gos/ rgyan/ zas gos kyi longs spyod rnams lha'i longs spyod la 'gran nus pa byas la gzhan yang phyogs bzhi nas las sgo re re phye snye khyed mtha'i nor rdzas thams cad kyang dbang med du nga'i sgo drung du 'dus shing / longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa na de ngo mtshar mi che 'am zhes 'khod 'dug pas/ rgyal po'i thugs bsam la nga'i bu mo 'di 'dod mkhan mang yang phugs su bod —kyi rgyal po de la ster dgos pa 3dra bsams zhing / thugs mi bde ba pho brang du byon no/ de nas yab rgyal po dang / yum btsun mo/ sras rgyal bu lha gcig kong jo bcas 'dzoms te gros byas pas/ rgyal pos ni chos rgya gar nas byung ba yin phyir de drin che bas rgya gar chos kyi rgyal por ster gsungs/ btsun mo ni longs spyod 'a/ sred zhen che dis ta1 /ga

nor gyi rgyal por ster zer/ zas rgyal bu dpa' rtsal 'dzom par dga' bas ge sar dmag gi rgyal por ster zer lha gcig rang nyid ni skyes gzugs legs par dga' bas bha ta hor gyi rgyal por mos te dza mi tshe gyil bu'i gtan grogs gal che zer/ de na nang par gnya' bo blon bo rnams rgyal po'i drung du 'dus te bod blon rnams kyis ni nged kha ༷snga bas lha gcig nged tshor sbyin zer/ hor rnams kyis lha gcig nged la ma ster na rgyal khams dmag gis 'gengs zhes zer/ ta zig rnam kyi lha gcig nged la ma ster na rgyal khams mes ba ga par bya'o zer/gi sar ba rnams kyis lha gcig nged la ma ster na rgyal khams chu 'geng ra ro/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyed gnya' bo blon po rnams la nye ring med/ rig pa gang sna ba gcig la ster rgyu yin pas rig pa 'gran dgos zhes gsungs so/ rgyal po'i bla g.yu sgor mo bya ba/ che chung por chung gi tshad tsam la bkrag che ba/ mig gcig mtha' na yod pa/ mig gcig dkyil na yod pa/ dbyibs phub kyi bang rim lta bu byas pa de dang dar skud gcig blon po tshor gtad nas/ g.yu 'di'i mig tu dar skud su stobargyu pa la lha gcig ltar gsungs so/ blon po mgar na ri/ khyed blon po tshan pa bzhi po la rgyal pos brtse/ dbang yang che bas khyed tshos bla g.yu'i mig tu dar skud ma tshud sngon la stos shig zer bas/ blon po ga/na rnams kyis snyung po dang / phag ze/ skud pa sogs bsags

nas re ri bsgo khrig 'grims kyis brgyus spyong tshud pa'i bas ma ༷ go de nas blon po mgar la nged rnams kyis ni ji ltar byas kyang mi cad/ di khyod kyis e tshud stos shig zer nas g.yu dang dar da gtad do di nas mgar rig pa ca des sngar nas 'bu grog ma gcig la gzan dang 'o mas gsos te khab sbom tsam du song yod pa de'i sked pa la dar skud btags/ ngar skud spyi bod bsdus des brtsengs te/ grog ma de g.yu'i mig tu btsud cing dar skud kyi sne lag tu blangs nas phu btab pas/ rlung gis ded nas grog ma skud pa dang bcas pa mtha' yi mig nas thon byung ba dang / grog ma'i sked pa nas dar skud bkrol te lag pas nur gyis 'then pas g.yu mig tu dar skud tshud do/ de nas mgar na re/ nged kyis de bzhin du byung yod pas lha gcig zhu byas pas/da dung rig pa 'gran dgos zer nas ma sbyin no/ yang de'i snyi nyin rgyal pos blon po tshan lnga por lug lnga brgya gtad nas de rnams sang gi nyin mor bsad zin pa dang / sha zos zin pa/ pags pa mnyes zin pa bcas byung na lha gcig ster zer ro/ der bod blon rnams kyis mi res lug re bsad nas sha logs shig tu spung /pags pa zur zhig tu bzhag sha lcag mo tsam re la tshwa bsgres nas ru bcug pas zos zin/ pags pa rnams gral 'go nas phur ba re byas ti btang bas gral gzhug tu snum byug ran/ 'og ma des rnam ri byugs te phur ba re byas pas pags pa thul lo/ blon po gzhan rnams rna1 gang

〉 ming rin par/ mgar na ri/ do nged kyi de bsgon sgo yod / gzhan gyis ma byung bar 'dug pas lha gcig nged 'a zhu byas pas/ ci la tha da dung rig pa 'gran dgogazer nas ma sbyin/ nang par yang chang ban brgya tham pa re gtad nas/ sang nyin mo tshun chad la btungs zin pa/ ma bo ba/ ma bzi ba su byung ba la bu mo ster zhes gsungs/ yang mgar gyis bod blon rnams la sgod chung chung rer chang nyung ngu re drangs te/ thog ma hub re 'thungs shig byas pas btungs zin pa dang / ma bo ba/ ma bzi ba byung / gzhan nams kyis btungs ma zin dogs nas phor pa chen por chang gis bkang ste 'thung log byas pas bzi zhing skyugs te bo 'dug go yang nged kyis de bzhin byung yod/ gzhan gyis ma byung bar 'dug pas lha gcig rgya'o byas pas/ da dung rig pa 'gran dgos zer/yang rta ma brgya bu brgya gtad nas 'di tsho ma bu phyogs gcig tu ngo shes pa la lha gcig ster zer/ yang gzhan gyis ma shes/ blon po stogar bas rta ma bu rnams khag so sor bzungs nas zhag gcig ring rtswa ma sbyin chu ma sbyin/ca de'i sang nyin rte'u rnams kyi khrod du btang pas/ rang rang gi ma gang la 'dug pa btsal nas 'o ma btungs pas ma bu ngo shes so/ mgar ba na re/ nged kyis ngo shes/ gzhan gyis ma shes pab lha gcig zhu'o byas pas/ da drang rig pa 'gran dgos zer nas ma ///

yang de'i sang nyin bya ma brgya bu brgya gtad nas de rnams ma bu ngo 'phrod pa su byung la lha gcig ster zer/ yang gzhan gyis ma shes/mgar gyis thang yangs pa zhig la spang ma gtor nas bzhag ste der bya rnams kha gtad do/ de'i tshe bya rnams gnyis gnyis lhan du za zhing /ske'i 'og na za zhing spyod pa 'tshub pa 'di rnams bu yin/ de min rnams ma yin no byas pas ngo shes/ nged kyis ngo shes gzhan rnams kyis ṭwāṃ tram̐ ṭwāṃ rdo ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ nag / ga zhu'o byas pas/ da dung rig pa 'gran dgos yang gsom gyi shing lhum dum brgya gtad nas 'di rnams kyi mgo gzhug sus shes pa la lha gcig nyer zer ro/ yang gzhan gyis ma shes sgron po mgar gyis shing de rnams chu 'gram du khyer nas chu la bskur bas/ rtsa ba gyi bas thur du song / rtse mo yang bas gyen du lus so/nged kyis ngo shes/ gzhan gyis ma shes pas lha gcig zhu'o byas pas/da dung rig pa 'gran dgos zer gas ma sbyin/ de nas yang nyin zhig pho brang nas rnga wa che brdungs pa dang / blon po tshan pa gzhan rnams pho brang du song / bod blon rnams kyi gnas mo na re/ blon po gzhan rnams pho brang du song /cho khyed cag mi 'gro 'am/phyin pa legs so zer bas/ mgar ba na re/ nged rnams la shog kyang mi zer/ rnga de ci yin cha med byas pas/ gnas mo na re/ blosapo gzhan rnams song ba na/ khyed rnams la shog mi zer yang 'gro /ra

'a da do/ der blon po mgar gyis rnga skyon can du go nas blon po rnams khrid de rang gi 'dug sa'i gnas khang gi sgo la mtshal gyi yi ge btab/ ya them la rdo rje bris/ ma them la g.yung drung ris bris/lam gyi sgo rnams bgrang zhing tshos kyi khu bas mtshan ma 'debs kyin pho brang du song ngo / pho brang nang blon po gzhan rnams 'tshogs 'dug de'i dgong mor rgyal pos gnya' bo blon po thams cad la ston mo bshams/thos kyi mun nag la/ rgyal po'i zhal nas khyed rang blon po thams cad phyir log la/ rang rang gi sdod khang brnyed pa gyis shig de sus brnyed pa la bu mo ster gsungs so mgar gyis pho brang nas mar me skag g.yar te/ sgo re re bzhin thon gyin sngar gyi mtshan ma rnams lta bzhin du phyin pas rang gi gnas khang brnyed do/ sang nam langs pa dang blon po gzhan rnams la blta bar snyin pas/ la la gzhan gyi khyim du tshud/ la la sgo ma brnyed nas rgya srang na nyal 'dug go/ yang mgar gyis nged kyis khang pa brnyed/ gzhan gyis khang pa ma brnyed par 'dug pas lha gcig zhu'o byas pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ da ni zhag gsum gyi rjes shar sgo thang la bu mo mtshar sdug dang ldan pa sum brgya rgyan gyis brgyan te gral du bzhugs/ —de'i kṣod du lha gcig /jo sdu / /na bas/ de sus ngo shes pa la bu mo ster ba yitshon zhes /ཿ de nas blon po mgar bas gan khang du phyir log sne gnas 5

dang phan tshun 'brel ba dam zab byas te gi dul 'jam mkhas kyi sgo na gnas mor bshad par/ nged bod blon rnams rgya nag tu slebs nas lo gcig song / rig pa 'gran nas nged sna/ lha gcig de nged tshor thob kyang brnyas nas ma sbyin/ lha gcig 'phrul gyi kong jo de grags che ba 'byug sgra dang 'dra ba zhig mod kyang zhal ngo ni ma mjal/ lha gcig de dang khyed gnyis shin tu mthun par yod 'dug pas/ ci 'dra zhig yod pa legs par bstan du mdzod/ da ni shin tu gal che ba yod do/zhag gsum rjes kyi nyin mor kong jo bu mo sum brgya'i dkyil du gral bsgrigs nas shar sgo'i thang la 'jog pas de sus ngo shes pa la ste rgyu yin zhes gsungs byung / blon po gzhan rnams dbang che bas sngon la khong tshos 'dem du 'ong / khong tsho gang rung gis ngo shes nas khyer las che/ nged la thob par dka'o/ gal te kho tshos ngo ma shes par 'dug nas/ nged kyis ngo shes na'ang brnyas te mi ster las che/ gzhan yang las dbang gis mjal ba'i skal ba thob kyang ci 'dra zhig yod pa mi sheg pas/ khyed kyis legs par ston rogs gyis/ ngas khyed la gang dgos de phul zer nas gser bye bre gang rngan par sbyin no/ der gnas mo na re/ khyed bod blon rnams bden/ rgyal po nye ring / blon po gzhan rnams la thob tu re 'dug cing / khong tsho rig pa lan gcig rno ba na ster ba 'dug lha gcig 'phrul gyi kong jo di nga'i dpon mo min khas rgyus nga che ste/ rgya nag ris la mkhas pa / rtsis kyisdu ngo

shes na nga gsod du 'ong bar jis/ ngas 'chad mi nus zer ro/ der mgar na re/ rtsis kyis ngo mi shes pa'i thabs nga la yod zer nas/khyi gyi sgo bsdams/ snyid po chen po gsum btsugs/ de'i steng du zangs chen po chus bkang ba gcig bzhag chu steng du bya sna tshogs kyi spu gtor/ phub dmar po gcig gis kha bcad/ de'i steng du gnas mo bzhag gnas mo'i sgo la rdza ma g.yogs/ ma'i thog tu drwa ba g.yogs/ rdza ma la bug pa sgrig bug pa dang drwa mig gi nang du zangs dung bcug 'di nas tshur bshad na rtsis kyis zin kyang yid mi che par 'byung bas khyed kyis legs par gsungs shig byas so/ de nas gnas mo na re/ blon po chen po legs par yid la zungs zhig lha gcig 'phrul gyi kong jo de ni bu mo gzhan pas che rgyu med/ skye gzugs gzhan pasamatshar rgyu med rgyan gos gzhan pas legs rgyu med/ de la ma yi khyad chos ni/ sku mdog rjo la dmar mdangs chags pa dang /zhal nas utpal thon po'i dri bro ba/ lus dri zhim pas g.yu yi sbrang ma zhig 'khor/ mkhur tshos g.yas rnga/'i steng na cho lo ris/ g.yon ma'i steng gepadma'i ris/ dpral ba'i dkyil na sin : ra'i thig le'i steng na maru ta ri rnal tsam zhig yod/ dung so dkar mor so zho yod/ lha gcig kong jo de bu mo sum brgya'i mthar mi yong / dkyil du'ang mi yong / g.yon gral bsgrigs pa'i drug gi gong du 'ong / lha gcig de yi sdus dang gos la rgya bsrungs te/ lus dang gos la rig sa med

pas/ mda' gsar pa gcig la dar le brgan kha gzu thogs/ lha gcig gi rtsar slebs 4dang / mos dar gos sham bu dzdza rtseg gi steng na phyam tso gcig gyon yod pas/ de'i gong ba nas mda' stong gis bzungs te 'then cig zer/ der mgar gyis don rnams yid la legs par bcangs shing / lus sems dga' bdes khyab par gyur nas gnya' bo blon po byingasal 'di skad ces bshad do/ nged bod blon rnams sngon cad kyang mgo thon/ da rung yang mgo thon pa zhig dgos so/ nged tsho rgya nag tu tshong la 'ongs pa min/ gnyen bshes skyong du 'ongs pa'ang min/ lha gcig de spyan drongs rna nged rnams mgo thon pa yin pas/ brtag pa legs par byed dgos so/ da ni zhag gsum chos kyi nyin mor bu mo sum brgya'i dkyil nas sus ngo shes pa la ster ba thag chod 'dug pas/ spyang glen mi nor ba byed dgos zhes zer ro/tshode nas zhag gsum rjes kyi nyin mor bu mo rgyan gyis brgyan pa sum brgya shar sgo'i thang la bsgrigs so/ rgya nag gi skye bo pho mo rgan gzhon rnams ltad mo la 'tshogs/ der rgyal po'i zhal nas/ blon po rnams sngar gyi go rim bzhin 'doms shig gsungs so/ der rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po'i blon po rnams byung ste/ gral gyi dkyil nas bu mo chas bzang zhing mdzes pa gnyis khrid nas/ gcig min kyang gcig nazer nas 'ur sgra dang rma sgra 'debs kyin song ngo / de'i rjes su ta zig nor gyi rgyal po'i /na po rnams byung ste bu mo mdzes ma gnyi16 tre

khrid nas snga ma ltar byas nas song ngo / de'i rjes la gi sar da ga /khargyal po'i blon po rnams byung nas bu mo mdzes ma gnyis khrid rdo ji /kha /ye ltar byas nas song ngo / de'i ris la lha ta hor gyi rgyal po'i blon rdzo rnams byung nas bu mo mdzes ma gnyis khrid na snga ma lhar byas song ngo / der blon po mgar gyis bltas pas de rnams thams cad min par she te rab tu dga' nas 'dzum dmul gyis shor ro/ mgar gyis mad 'di lag tu bzungs/ bod blon rnams khrid nas g.yon gra du gtad phyin/ gral gyi ma 'a ma'i bu mo de la mgar na re/ 'di ni shan pa'i bu mo 'dra/mag pa 'di yi dmar lugs bsam/de mi gong du 'dug pa de/rdza mkhan gcig gi bu mo 'dra/lag par ra kha mang lugs bsam/di yi gong na 'dug pa de/zhing mkha gcig gi bu mo 'dra/gyon pa 'di yi skya lugs bsam de yi gong na dug pa de/'bab mkhan gcig gi bu mo 'dra/steng gos 'di ni snum lugs bsam/de yi sung na 'dug pa de/

gyis mkhan gcig gi bu mo 'dra/'bring bu 'di yi mang lugs bas //de yi gong du 'dug pa de/mgar mkhan gcig gi bu mo 'dra/gos kyi thu ba'i nag lugs bsam/de yi gong na 'dug pa de /dar 'thag bu mo yin pa 'dra/dar zab lus la gyon lugs bsam/de yi gong na 'dug pa de/ lha gcig kong jo yin pa 'dra sku mdog rjo la dmar mdangs chags/zhal nas utpal sngon po ldang / dri zhim g.yu yi sbrang bu 'khor/mkhur tshos ca lo padma ris/dbral bar rje btsun sgrol ma'i mtshan/so 'tshag dam nga so zho can 'phrul na bu mo gzhan las mdzes/ zhigapa sogs kyi yon tan brjod de/ lha gcig kong jo'i gos kyi gong ba nas mda' stong gis bzung snye 'a na pas/ lha gcig bshum bzhin blon po'i phyir 'brang so/ der lha gcig bshum pa la blon po //ra

gyis sgo ba skyes pa'i ces blangs te thob mi kun tu ba nga po dang /'ji se ru gong sto/ gnyisdu kyis rasdu bu bteg nas 'di skad do/tsho / /ci/ rshaX rajo mkhye/da bdag gi tshig la gson/bkra shes nyams su dga'/bod kyi rgyal khams ni/rin chen lnga las grub/ri la po'i pho brang nang / — mi rje lha yis mdzad/srong btsan sgam po de/ rigs gzugs dpal dang ldan/mthong na mas yid 'phrogathugs rje chen po lags/ —rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs/'bangs rnams bka' la nyan/rgyal blon 'khor 'bangs rnam /dga' skyed glu ru len/bde skyid 'tsho 3 thob/ dpal gyi thon bteg

ri la shing sna 'a mas/ —sa gzhi yangs pa la/'bya sna lnga yi tshogs/go mtshams med par skyes/gser dngul zangs lcags sogs/rin chen du ma yod/gnag rta lug gsum rgyas/dga' skyid de ltar yod/ ci— ma ngo mtshar che/lhagacig kong jo gson/ rī zhes thu blangs pas/ lha gcig gi dgongs pa la/ de ltari bden na rang gi yul dang 'dra ba 'dug bsams nas mchi ma phyis te blon po'i phyir 'brangs so/ blon pos rta la bskyon nas khrom skor byas te/ rgya hor gnyis las lhag pa nged bod yin no/ lha gcig nged kyis spyan brangs pa min pas thams cad khar mdzub mo chug la sdod byas so/ deramo rgya nag gi mi rnams kyis smre sngags bton te nged tsho'i lha gcig mdzangs ma de bod blon rnams kyis khyer song zhes zer ro/ der rgyal po'i zhal na / blon po gzhan rnam pa tsho/ khyed rnams kyang nged rgya nag dang sa 'brel gnyen zla yin pas/ khyed rang tshos bdams pa'i bu mo rnams khrid la so so'i yul du song zhig gsungs so/ lha

blon po mgar gyi lha gcig la/ da ri bod la 'gro grabs gyis shig byas te btang pas lha gcig pho brang du byon rgyal po'i zhal nas khyod bod kyi rgyal po'i btsun mor 'gro dgos gsungs pas/ lha gcig na re/ nga yi pha ma bzhag nas 'gro mi nus zhes zer/ yab na re khyod de ltar ma zer 'gro dgos/ bod kyi rgyal po de mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs dang ldan pa zhig yod par 'dug de 'brel rnam dpyod ldan pa dang / dpa' mdzangs thabs mkhas kyis rgyal srid skyong ba/ 'bangs rnams rgyal po'i bka' la nyan cing brtsi bkur che ba/ sa gzhi byin chags shing bde skyid dang ldan pa yod 'dug na/ de bas phyin pa /sduX tram̐ gsungs pas/ der lha gcig gi yab la phyag 'tshal te rgya ga ༷༷/ gcig rgyal pos bka' gnang ngam/ ma ma yum gyis gawang lags sam/ jo jo ming pos tshig zhor ram/ mee ma srid pa ngo mtshar che/bod kyi yul der bdag btang na/ kha lbe can gyi yul phyogs der/ bsil zhing grang la sa bab mtho/ gangs ri gcan ga na ches mang ba brag ri 'brong gi rwa dang 'dra/ 'byu sna mi skyes mu ge'i gnas/gdol pa sha za srin po'i rigs spyod pa rtsings pa sla klo'i ming /mtha' 'khob sangs rgyas zhabs mi bcag zhes zhu pas/ yab kyis thugs brtse'i ngang nas bka' gnang bar/ nga yi mig dang 'ang ba'i bu mo 'od/

bod ces bya ba kha ba can gyi yul/ yul las khyad par 'phags pa de min no/gangs ri rang bzhin mchod rten grub pa'i gnas/mtsho bzhi g.yu yi maṇḍal bkram pa 'dra/ya mtshan gser gyi me tog rgyas pa'i gling ba la la mdzes pa lha gnas gzhal yas khang /chu bo bzhi 'bab rtsi shing nags kyis mdzes/'bru sna lnga 'khrungs rin chen sna tshogs 'byung /rkang bzhi kun khyab rtsi thog mar la spyod/de ltar ngo mtshar che ba'i gnas mchog der/rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i pho brang nang /mi — lha yi mdzangs pa'i rgyal po de/'phags pa thugs rje chen po dngos su 'dug thabs mkhas thugs rje ldan pa'i rgyal po yin/mi dge bcu spangs dge bcu'i khrims la gnas/mnga' thang dpal 'byor 'dod dgu'i dpal la spyod/yon tan mtha' yas rgyal po lha yi sras/dpa' mdzangs kun 'dzoms 'khor rnams byang chub sems/de 'dra'i gnas su bu mo khyod song zhigamadzes ma khyod kyis bcad nams bsags pa'i rten/31

bdag gi mchod pa'i gnas kyi sku gzugs de/yon bdag lha yi brgya byin gong gis rmejod/rgyu ni rin chen rnam pa bcu las grub 'di yi bzo ba ba shā garngas mdzad/ rab gnas sangs rgyas rang gis gnang tho lags/de ltar 'gran med rgyal ba'i sku gzugs der/mthong thos dran reg gsol ba btab 'gyur na/ sangs rgyas myur du thob pa rgyal bas gsungs/gser g.yu brtsegs pa'i yig tshang che mo dang /gtsug lag yi gi sum brgya drug cu dang /gser g.yu rgyan gyi rnam pa mang po yang /mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdagagis brdzangs/g.yos sna zas kyi rnam pa mang po dang /btung ba skom gyi sbyor thabs mang po dang /gser sga gtsu yi ka leb can la sogs/mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs/za 'og stan thul seng ge bya brgyad ma/ljon shing cho lo nor bu ris su bris/ rgyal po ngo mtshar skye phyir khyod la brdzangs/rgya yi gab rtse gtsug lag sum brgya dang /

bdag gi mchod pa'i gnas kyi sku gzugs de/yon bdag lha yi brgya byin gong gis rmejod/rgyu ni rin chen rnam pa bcu las grub 'di yi bzo ba ba shā garngas mdzad/ rab gnas sangs rgyas rang gis gnang tho lags/de ltar 'gran med rgyal ba'i sku gzugs der/mthong thos dran reg gsol ba btab 'gyur na/ sangs rgyas myur du thob pa rgyal bas gsungs/gser g.yu brtsegs pa'i yig tshang che mo dang /gtsug lag yi gi sum brgya drug cu dang /gser g.yu rgyan gyi rnam pa mang po yang /mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdagagis brdzangs/g.yos sna zas kyi rnam pa mang po dang /btung ba skom gyi sbyor thabs mang po dang /gser sga gtsu yi ka leb can la sogs/mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs/za 'og stan thul seng ge bya brgyad ma/ljon shing cho lo nor bu ris su bris/ rgyal po ngo mtshar skye phyir khyod la brdzangs/rgya yi gab rtse gtsug lag sum brgya dang /

legs nyes ston pa'i las kyi long yang / mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs/bkod pa'i rig byed mdzes par byed pa yi yid 'ong rgyan gyis khyad par 'phags pa dang bzo yi rig byed drug cu tham pa yang /mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis ba ngas/bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi nad rnams 'joms pa'i sman/brtag thabs brgya dang dpyad lnga sbyong drug dang /sbyor sde bzhi la sogs pa bdag gis bskur/tshe gcig dros pa'i dang gos za 'og sogs/kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa'i rgyan gos kyang /stong phrag nyi shu bu mo khyod la ba ngas/rigs gzugs lta na sdug cing mdzes pa yi sems mthun skyo grogs byed pa'i bu mo yang /nyi shu rtsa lnga khyod kyi 'khor du ba ngas kha ba can gyi mi rnams 'dul don du/ rgyad kyi bya ba spyod lam 'di bzhin gyis/lta ba yangs shing spyod lam zhib par mdzod ngag 'jam smra mkhas bcas la legs par mdzod/snyi nang bya ba kun la mkhas par mdzod

rje la gus skang khor la byams par mdzod/khrel yod ngo tsha bag dang ldan par mdzod/ ma 'bral bar mi phod bu mo khyod/brtse ba'i snying gtam yin pas sems la thogaces pa la sogs pa'i 'jig rten mi chos la dgos pa'i bslab bya dpag tumed pa mdzad do/ der lha gcig kong jos yab kyi phyag nas 'jus shing 'bral mi phod pa byung na yang / bod la mi 'gro thabs med du dgongs nas yab dang gyis te pho brang phyir byon no/ de nas lha gcig g.yog mo dang 'grogs nas bod blon mgar gyi rtsar byung ste/ blon po chen po/ khyedakyi yul du jo bo shākya mu ni gdan 'dren/ nor rdzas dpag tu med pa khyer nas 'gro 'o/ khyed kyi yul du sa khams pa yod dam/ rdo brin zan yod dam/ shing se ba yod dam/ rtswa dres ma yod dam/ nyung ma yod dam/ zer ba la/ mgar na re/ gzhin rnams yod/ nyung ma med byas pas/ 'o na bod du so nam bya gtub pa 'dug gsungs nas nyung ma'i sa bon yang dar le brgan nang btums nas skra gseb tu bcugade nas jo bo shākya mu ni shing rta'i steng du bzhag de rgyud lha dga' thu dga' bya ba rgya yul gyi mi stobs che ba gnyis kyis 'dren/ di'i snyi na lha gcig kong jo g.yog mo bzhi dang 'grogs nas byon pa'i 'khor lo dre'u dkar mo gnyis kyis 'dren/ de'i rjes su rin po che rgyan du mas mdzes pa'i 'khor mdzes pa'i bu mo nyi shu rtsa lnga yang rang rang gi rta la bzhon nas3

bod du byon no/ bod du 'byon khar rgyal pos bod blon rnams la ston mo gnang sbyin dpag tu med pa mdzad/ gzhan yang rin po che sna tshogs dngadadar sa rgyan dang / 'phral gyi yo byad rnam bkal ba rta dang /dre'u thang po che la sogs pa mang po ba nga / yab mu gnyi kyis thug 'a nga bzhi du 'jig rten mi chos la dgos pa'i bslab bya dpag tu da pa mdzad yab yum blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pas skyel thung gom de/ skabs dir blon po 'bri ru gong ston pyi ba des blon po mgar la brag dogatabyas rin / 'dir lha gcig kong jo'i mi tshab tu blon so rig po can zhig bsdad na rgya bod gnyis mthun la chen po 'ong zer ske 0 nas/ blon po mgar la mig ce rer bltas pa dang rgyal po'i zhag nas/ nga'i lha gcig mdzangs ma 'di khyod bod la thob pas 'dir rgya bod mjo' 'grel gyi slad du mgar ba mi tshab tu sdod dgos ga zhungs so/ blon po mgar gyis kyang 'bri ru gong sto gyis brag dog byas pa yin par go nas/ rgya bod mthun lam du phan ther ngas byas yong ja per na sdod rgyu rgya / de nas mgar gyis thon mi rang / nyang blon gnyis zur du bad nos/ nga gye nag tu zla ba lnga las mi sdod/ ci de tsham khyed rnams kyi rdzus pa'i spang po zhig nga'i rtsar thong bya so/ de nabarka:blon po 'khor dang bcas pa 5 bo dang lha gcig la bskor mu bodarwa'i — chas so/ nyin der gar thebs pa'i sa der ba do na khyi shu mu rna dar — dkar gi yol phung pa'i nang du bzhugs/ de na 'bra rgyag rna su ba'istami

bskol nas lha gcig skang jo la drangs/ de'i nyin mor blon 'khor rnam dga' skyid rtsed lajor zhugs ྅/ la la rta rgyugs 'gran/ la la bang 'gran/ la la mda' shed 'gran pha la sogs pa'i sgyu rtsal sna tshogs byed do lha gcig kong jo ni mchod pa sna lnga bshams nas dngu'i gyi tam bu ṭwāṃ // dag/ma pa sgyur cing sbreng bas tam bu ra'i dbyangs dang bcas thu gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo khyed bltams tshe sa chenaci 'di la gom pa bdun bor nas/ nga ni 'jig rten 'di na mchog ces gsungs/ de tshepa mas pa khyod la phyag 'tsha po/ rnam dag sku lnga mchog tu gzugs ba nga ba/ mi shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra/ grags pa 'jig rten ga ma na lha nge ba mgon po mchog nyid la ni skyabs su ma /zhis pa la sogs pa shākya mu de'i bstod pa bya so/ yang nang par bya kṣa ta'i skad kyi ma non gong gu chas te/ lha gcig gis shākya mu de'i sne drangs te lam du zhugs so/ride yang rgya nag tu mgar gcig pur lus te/ rgya rjes blon po mgar rig pa rno bas rigs rgyud spel du re nas lang yang kong jo'i tsha mogazugs byad legs ca zhig chung mar sbyin/ gzhis bzang rab gcig bad nas bzhag go/ sa der cagar shin tu skyo ste nga bod du ma btang na gnya' bo tshan pa bzhi pos kong jo bod du gdan 'dren pa la 'phro sdu tu 'ong bas/ rigs bzang gi bu dpa' rtsal can lo nyi shu 'on pa

brgya skyil mar thongs sheg byas pas btang ngo / de nas blon po mgar snyibasarigs rgyud 'phel gyi dogs nas chung ma de'i sar ma phyin par rang sgo khang khyim chung ngu'i nang nyal nas bsdad/ tsho sa ci sbyin pa thams cad thabs byas te ma bzas/ nyi mar rtag tu nyal thos blon po lus shin tu rin ba dang bzhin tho nag tu song / 'gram pasayas su ram dang g.yon du rgya skyegs byugs/ lud pa bor ba rnag gi mdo ga rjo dmar du byung / nyam sa'i 'og tu pags pa spron pa bting / de'i steng du gdan gzhan brnying nas nyal bas rgya mo tshor nas 'dri ba byas par/ kye blon po chen po yar la bzhengs/ 'dris pa'i chung ma bdag cal tshur gson dang / bzhin ras nyams shing dri ngan kha ba' rgyu/ ma — ga sta drang gtam bdag la gsung bar zhu/ 0zhes zer ba de'i lan du mgar na re/ nga yi lus la tshad pa'i nad byung ba khyed kyis ma shes sa /de nas nyin zhig rgyal blon 'khor dang bcas pha bod blon mgar gyi sar byon nas/ khyod la gros gyi mdun ma mang po bya rgyu yod gsungs pa ga rjod po mgang na re/ rgya rje rgyal po lags/ bdag sa chad pa'i nad kyis mnar nas 'chi nyen lags zhuba'ipas/ der rgyal pos gzigs pas sgron lamagar ni na ba dang / 'dar ba/ rid pa 'dug cing / lud pa ga bskyur bas rnag gi mdog tu byung / snyi nang gang sar bskyur ba'i lud pa skam po kun gzigs nas blon po shi bar dogs/ de shi na mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal po snang btsan sham po'i blon po rig pa can yin pas/ཿ/nga

btsan sgam pos sku lus kyi bkod pa sngo stong du sprul nas dmag 'ongs pa na nga bde mi yong snyam nas bred/ des na rgyal pos sman pa mkhas pa zhigapos nas nad de bcos shig gsungs/ der blon po mgar bas grang khang rdu bsngad nas nga la dri mi zhim pa yod pas gzhan la gnod zer nas sgo bcad de chu nang du thag pa'i sne gcig bcug gcig skar khung na phar btang ste sman pa —mkhas par gtad pas/ rgya'i sman pas ba sa rdzis bshad par/ nad gzhan ci yang mi 'dug 'byung ba chu'i rang bzhin du 'dug pas grang ba bcos dgos zer/ de nas yang nang par tshe nyapa 'ong pa dang / blon pos thag sgo gcig me la bcug sne gcig skor khung na btang / sman thas blta rjes bshad par /ngo zhan blon po'i snyun gzhi 'gyur 'dug me yi rang bzhin du 'dug /chos dro ba bcos dgos zeng ro/ yang nang par sman pa thongs nas blta po / blon po mgar gyis — ga sne gcig mchig la btags/ sne ga ga gtad pas/ sman pa na re/ ci yin blon po'i snyun nad 'gyur 'dug tsho ba ba rdo yi rang bzhin la rtsa lag bskor nas so ris bzhin du 'khrug 'dug zer/ yang blon pos zhum bu zhig mgo mjug bslogs na dpyang la btag / de'i rkang par thag pa sbrel nas sne gcig ra khung mar sprad pas/ sman pa na re/ da ci yin smad bag thams cad stod rdu rgyugs/ stod khrug thams cad smad la bsdus nas gcan ga na ma'i rtsa las mi 'dug pas ngas bcos mi shes zer nas song ngo der zus ri tsho

zhin tu bred na yang de min ban pa mkhas pa zhig bos/ blon po mgar gyi zung ma khyod do nub sgo phyir nyol/ khyod bud med bya ba grib che ba minapha nang par sman pas nga'i rtsa mi rtogs/ de ltar song na nga 'chi khyod la sa/ za phog nas 'ong zer te mo phyi la bston de nas mal gyi sgab mthon por byas nas spyi bo sa la btsugs te nyal bas rtsa thams cad 'khrugs/ jon pas ba sa rjes rgyal por zhus par/ rgyal po lags/ blon po chen po'i snyun gzhi de chang mas 'gyur ba yang ma zhan/ mkhris pa las 'gyur ba'ang ma na/ de bzhin du bad gan dang bgegs rigs stong phralakhabargyad cu la sogs pa'i nad gang yang mi gda'/ de ma yin pa'i nad chen po gcig 'dug pas ngas kyang bcos mi shes zer ro/ de nas rgya rje chu ri/ blon po mgar khyed rig pa rno bas rgya'i ston thog ji ltar byas na legs/ so nam ji ltar byas na smin gsungs pas/ blon po mgar gyis sa bon yos sel tsam brngos nas btab na long tshan che zhing zla ba gsum tshams legs par smin 'ong zer/ rgya'i so nam bas blon po'i nga rte harī zas pas zla ba gsum tsam lon pa na ljang pa tsam las ma thon/ blo po bsam par da ni nga la chad sgyupa 'ong nges snyam nas babs bya te da de nga zhag ma bdun las 'chi ba 'dug nga sa thag ring so 'gir thebs grogs blon po rnams kyis bskyur/ lus la nad kyis mnar/ nga rang /ji rgyal po dang gnyen nye du mdza' bshes yid la dran kyang tram̐ babs med/ dnghaji ltar/ byas kyang nga 'chi ba las mi 'dug zer nas mgo ༷tu sa rta ci

nyal rgyal po thugs na tu ma bde bar/ blon po na khri/ khyed rig pa can yin pas thabs shes mee yod/ de'i thabs gang 'gru byed gsu ngas pas/ blon po'i bsam par da ni ngas glags rnyed pa 'dug rib ma nas/ rgyal po chen po/ ngal nad 'di bcas thabs la khyed las nga bzang / bod kyi lha srung ma dga' ba yin/ nga bod kyi ri mthong ba'i ji 'go mthon po zhig gi khar song nas lha gsol na phan/ de'i rdzas la dar zab me la bsregs pa'i thal ba rkyal pa gang / lug gro mo ba da pa'i mtsher zag grod pa gang / sol ba'i gdung shing gas chag mid pa 'dom gang / rta mog ro mgo dmar gcig bcas dgos/'on kyang de rnams ni brnyed pa ra dka' ste mi 'dzoms/ rgyal pos kyang gnang bar dka'o/ de bas 'chi ba las 'os med/ nga 'chi ba'i rje su ltas ngan bco brgyad 'ong / rgya bod gnyis spru gnod pa che zhes rgyas pas/ rgyal po na re/ khyed spruphan pari thabs gang 'grub bya'o/ da de nyol cig gsungs nas byon no/ der rgyal pos nagaso thams cad la me brgyab kyang gdung shing ni ma byung / lug gro mo thams cad bsad kyang mtsher khrag phor pa gyed ka tsam yang rim byung / rta mog ro mgo dmarade brnyed do/ rgyal po na re rdzas rnams ni ma brnyed/ rta mog ro mgo dmar de brnyed yod do gsungs pas/ blon po mgar gyis zhus par/ —nga gzhan rnam —ma brnyed na thabs zad/ rta mog ro mgo dmar gle nga'i ṭwāṃ rta gyis la nga bskyon/ rgya yul na bzang ba'i rta gcig la nga'i ro

sa dang ro gos bkal nas bod kyi ri mthong ba'i sar bod lha ga la du 'gro ra/ lha gsol bar 'gro ba'i grabs byas te blon pos rta mog ro ma dmar bzhon/ rta gzhan de la zas gos rgyan lta sogs pa bka /— blon po bros dogs nas rgya yi spyad mi bzhi btang ba dang bcas bod kyi ri mgo mthong ba'i ra lha gsol du chas so ci ri de yang rgyal po na re nga'i lha gcig de bod blon rnams la ston mkhan zhig byung 'dug pa ga rngod pa gyis shig gsungs ga der rtsi byas rjes rtsis pa rnams gyis 'di da ca gsol po/ — ri bo gsum steng rgya mtsho 'a la ba 'dug mtsho mo'i nang —5 'dab chags sna tshogs gnas/ bad med mgo lus mnyam zhing mig ri gci khengs/ ngas kyi mchu can zhig gis bshad nas 'dug ce zhu par/ rgyal po de 'dra mi srid gsungs nas thugs yid ma che par rtsis yig thams cad me la ba ga / thor thang brgyad cu skyor ya la ni bod du bskur nas med do/ de yang blon po mgar gyis bod du 'ong ba'i lam bar srung bha snyed mi bzhi khrid nas rgya mo tsha ba'i rong rgyud bod kyi ri mthong ba'i sar ma sprebs bar zas ma sbyin/ ri mthong ba'i sar slebs pa dang sha skam po la tshwa btab nas ltar te blon pos lha gsol lo/ —gsol mo gsol lo lha gsol lo/ bod kyi lha klu gnyan gsum gsol/ srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu gsoX/ rje yi dbu lha bcu //ma

gsol/ bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis gsol/ blon po'i bsa'adzidon 'grub par skag ces lha gsol nas chang bzang po la bang rgod btab nas lha la masngod rje bsang bya rgyad mi bzhi la sbyin pas khong bzhi tha skyems shing nga mang du btungs pas ra ros te gnyid du yur/ mgaragyis khong bzhi'i mtshon cha rnams pa ga rta bzhi mi rmig pa la lcags ga ra btab blon po nyid ring rta sogado mgo dmar bzhon nas bod du khro / spyod mi bzhi gnyid sad rgyus blon sga med/ mtshon cha chag dasnyams su rgyur/ rta yi lag pa'ang tha pha / khong rnams na re/ rang tsho mir ci ga na rgya po chod pa gcod/ rna ma jod blon gyi rjes su 'brangs na 'gro 'o zhe zer te blon ba'i rjes su bsnyegs bas blon sdos sung nye ring ran par byas te mig rgyang re tsham la sa bag leb je ba gi 'ong / de nas blon po rgya ku khug pa'i 'gram du slebs nas 'asdir rtag ngas dang rta rjes mang du bzhag na sa kheng cipar byas/ gan ba'i rwa mi la bsregs nas gzhu bcos/ mda' mang po brgyab nas mdang rmesgro'i sa mas bar sa la btsud bzhag de nas rjes 'ded pa rnams 'byor nas 'di skad do/ kho ba ri sa rta pa mang la rtsal che ba byung nge /// //shā /lha kho thub phyir log 'gro ba drag zer te rgya chu khug pa — tshode yang skabs der lha gcig dpre jo bod blon 'khor dang bcas oṃ lda/ ma brag rtsar phebs nas/ brag ldebs su byags pa spyo bdun pa
